d:
Bihar men mahagathbandhan ki votar adhikar yatra men bari sankhya men log jut rahe hain. rahul gandhi aur tejasvi yadav in railiyon ka netritv kar rahe hain aur logon tak apni bat pahunchane ki koshish kar rahe hain. in railiyon men shamil hone aae kuchh log jahan rahul gandhi ko dekhne pahunch rahe hain to kuchh apni mangon ki chitthi lekar. vahin kuchh logon ko shikayat ye bhi hai ki rahul unse us tarah nahin mil rahe jaise unki dadi mila karti thin.
Dekhie, bihar ke alag-alag zilon se bibisi sanvaddata situ tivari aur shahanvaz ahmad ki ye riport.
